column1: # header in docs/content/schema.md §4). Read at eve-bots startup from
# ./content/bots/difficulty.tsv when it is there, else this compiled-in copy.
# One row, one constant at one level; edit the value and restart the bots.
# Level 0 peaceful, 1 easy, 2 normal, 3 hard, 4 brutal. It scales bot
# behaviour only; the server, NPCs, CONCORD and prices do not change.
